implementation: ACodeRescueCharacter calls UCodeRescueGameInstance::IncrementDeathCount, which writes SaveDeathRecoveryCheckpoint without storing a zero-health pawn.
player_contract: Death records progress, selected language, and death count while keeping the language save playable.

implementation: UCodeRescueGameInstance stores FCodeRescueCampaign::GetPlayerStartLocation(CurrentObjectiveIndex), a safe facing rotation, restored health, and minimum recovery resources.
player_contract: Resume from death replays the current city from its entry pad instead of reopening into the defeat spot.

trigger: Death screen RESUME FROM LANGUAGE SAVE
implementation: UCodeRescueDeathWidget calls ResumeLanguageRun with the active ECodingLanguage before reopening the level.
player_contract: The player returns to the same language-only profile selected on the start screen.

trigger: Death screen SAVE THIS LANGUAGE RUN AND QUIT
implementation: UCodeRescueDeathWidget calls SaveDeathRecoveryCheckpoint(false), updates the status line, logs CodeRescueDeathFlow, then quits.
player_contract: Relaunching still shows the start screen, and that screen can resume the saved language checkpoint.

trigger: Death screen START FRESH LANGUAGE RUN
implementation: UCodeRescueDeathWidget deletes only the active language save slot and reloads the level.
player_contract: Players can restart the selected language run without disturbing saves for other coding languages.

implementation: UCodeRescueDeathWidget logs the active language slot and quits without another live-state save.
player_contract: QA can distinguish save-and-quit from an immediate quit in runtime logs.
